# Rory Cai

> Personal site and tech blog of Rory Cai: frontend, React Native, iOS / Android and developer productivity.

Rory Cai, Full-stack Developer. Graduated from Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen). Currently a frontend engineer at Tencent.
Tech stack: TypeScript, Vue, Nuxt, React Native, Tailwind, Kotlin, Objective-C, Golang, Node.js, Python, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana.
GitHub: https://github.com/Coiggahou2002

Every post is available in English (under /) and Chinese (under /zh/).

## For agents

- Every page has a plain-Markdown twin: add `.md` to the URL without the trailing slash, e.g. https://coiggahou2002.github.io/blogs/nginx.md
- All English posts in one file: https://coiggahou2002.github.io/llms-full.txt (Chinese: https://coiggahou2002.github.io/zh/llms-full.txt)
- Post index (JSON, both languages): https://coiggahou2002.github.io/api/posts.json
- Résumé (JSON Resume): https://coiggahou2002.github.io/resume.json
